findings.claim: phase('Gate') is called inside the pipeline() second-stage callback, so with more than one template the 'Gate' phase marker is re-emitted once per template. Every other workflow in this change set hoists each phase() call once at top level: phase('Render') is hoisted at line 50 of this same file, foreign-toolchain-pretag.js (same batch, same author) puts both phase('Build') (line 43) and phase('Gate') (line 58) at top level, session-mine.js calls phase('Drift'/'Mine'/'Route') at top level, and subsystem-grounding.js calls phase('Ground')/phase('Fold') at lines 57/79 top level. config-ui-fidelity-gate.js is the sole file placing a phase() call inside a loop body, diverging from the one-call-per-phase house pattern (ACTION-REVIEW-QUALITY-001: code follows project conventions / structure).
